description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notification under the Finance Act, No. 35 of 2018
categorisation: This gazette notification amends tax regulations under the Finance Act, specifically modifying deadlines for luxury tax on motor vehicles. It constitutes a regulatory amendment (legal/statutory instrument) rather than involving government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister's name and title is incidental to the legal/regulatory action being taken.
